Geometry-derived analysis shows Bi and Fe each coordinated by six O neighbors, while La is surrounded by nine O neighbors; O centers have three geometric neighbors, two Bi and one Fe or one Bi and two Fe. Polyhedron-sharing analysis indicates corner- and edge-sharing between Bi and Fe 6-vertex coordination polyhedra, and corner-sharing between Bi and La 9-vertex polyhedra. The geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional and spans all 36 sites.
